'''Li Junxian''' ({{zh|s=李俊贤}}; 10 March 1928 – 20 March 2024) was a Chinese chemist and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]].<ref name="ra">{{cite news |author1=Liu Juan ({{lang|zh|刘娟}}) |author2=Li Qing ({{lang|zh|李庆}}) |author3=Wang Yuexin ({{lang|zh|王越欣}}) |url=https://new.qq.com/rain/a/20240322A084TJ00 |script-title=zh:痛别！眉山籍院士李俊贤逝世 学生刘丹：他是我眼里的传奇人物 |work=qq.com |date=22 March 2024 |access-date=23 March 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>

Li was a representative of the [[15th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]].<ref name="ra"/>

==Early life and career==
Li was born into a family of farming background in [[Meishan|Meishan County]] (now Meishan), [[Sichuan]], on 10 March 1928.<ref name="ra"/> In 1947, he enrolled at National Central Technical College (now Chengdu Textile College), where he majored in chemical engineering.<ref name="ra"/>

After graduating in 1950, he became deputy director of Pilot Plant at Shenyang Chemical Research Institute of Northeast Chemical Bureau.<ref name="ra"/> He joined the [[Chinese Communist Party]] (CCP) in June 1956. He studied at the Russian Language Training Class of the {{ill|Ministry of Chemical Industry (China)|zh|中华人民共和国化学工业部|lt=Ministry of Chemical Industry}} between June 1956 and July 1957. He was transferred to the Beijing Institute of Chemical Engineering in January 1958 and eventually becoming director of the Research Room in January 1960.<ref name="ra"/> In June 1966, he was appointed chief engineer of Qinghai Liming Chemical Plant (later was reshuffled as {{ill|Liming Chemical Research Institute|zh|黎明化工研究院}}), and served until October 1992.<ref name="rc">{{cite book |language=zh |editor1=Zheng Rumin ({{lang|zh|郑汝民}}) |script-title=zh:中国共产党河南省洛阳市组织史资料 |trans-title=Organizational History of Luoyang  |year=2002 |publisher=Communist Party History Publishing House |location=Beijing |isbn=7-80136-717-0}}</ref> He also served as president from July 1979 to May 1983.<ref name="rc"/>

== Personal life and death ==
Li married Ding Dayun ({{zh|s=丁大云|labels=no}}) in 1959.<ref>{{cite news |author1=Li Yanan ({{lang|zh|李亚楠}}) |url=http://www.xinhuanet.com/politics/2018-06/30/c_1123059254.htm |script-title=zh:做国家腾飞的“推进剂”——记中国工程院院士李俊贤 |work=xinhuanet.com |date=30 June 2018 |access-date=23 March 2024 |language=zh}}</ref> On 20 March 2024, Li died of heart failure in [[Luoyang]], [[Henan]], at the age of 96.<ref name="ra"/>

==Honours and awards==
* 1989 State Technological Invention Award (Third Class) for the synthesis process of high-purity unsymmetrical dimethylhydrazine by chloramine method<ref name="rb">{{cite news |url=https://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2024/3/519412.shtm |script-title=zh:李俊贤院士逝世 |work=sciencenet.cn |date=20 March 2024 |access-date=23 March 2024 |language=zh}}</ref>
* 1995 State Science and Technology Progress Award (Second Class) for the research on liquid unit based propellants such as Yutu-3<ref name="rb"/>
* 1995 Member of the [[Chinese Academy of Engineering]] (CAE)<ref name="rb"/>
